title: Calendar always proposes a date; a meter in No data proposes nothing
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule whose service has more than one active trigger (e.g. a calendar interval and a mileage 'At' target), e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12'.
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the worklist and a work order's maintenance panel show the same rows).
custom_steps:
1. On a unit with no usable meter history (No data), read the Due.
  2. On a unit with a usable meter estimate, read the Due.
  3. Open the row menu on the No-data unit.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The calendar always proposes a candidate date.
  • A meter in No data proposes nothing.
  • A meter with no usable delta is silent rather than wrong, and the row menu never hides a candidate.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10569 (S12, Due date resolution); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S12; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S12-N2: “The row menu never hides a candidate”
